root_policy.boundary: B3_D6_off_table_physics_implementation_allowed remains false until this independent gate is revalidated

measured_table_asset.use: offline provenance for sealed analytic dimensions only; runtime collision may not query renderer mesh

dimension_provenance.rail_top: sealed maximum y of bound table OBJ; renderer y scale is one
dimension_provenance.outer_rail_xz: sealed OBJ x/z extrema multiplied by existing width/length model scales
dimension_provenance.outside_landing: explicit physical world floor plane; never inferred from a rendered pixel or mesh at runtime

coordinate_and_profile_contract.validation: all values finite; radius and extents positive; gravity strictly negative; cloth < rail_top; outside_landing < cloth; outer extents strictly contain the playfield; canonical profile serialization includes every new field

physical_domain_contract.cloth_supported: center y is exactly cloth surface plus radius and existing XZ sliding/rolling integration remains the control path
physical_domain_contract.airborne: exact constant acceleration p(t)=p0+v0*t+0.5*g*t^2 and v(t)=v0+g*t for each analytic tail; no cloth friction while unsupported
physical_domain_contract.cushion_nose: continuous swept-sphere collision against the pocket-excised inner rail solid; the nose reference height uses the profile formula and low trajectories may not tunnel through it
physical_domain_contract.rail_top: continuous swept-sphere landing/contact against the horizontal top of the analytic rail solid, followed by supported surface motion; its inner and outer edges remain continuous collision features
physical_domain_contract.outside_landing: continuous swept-sphere contact with the explicit floor plane only outside the outer rail footprint; landing inside the cabinet/rail footprint is not accepted as an outside landing
physical_domain_contract.departure: a physical domain transition to AIRBORNE whose sphere center crosses the outer rail envelope after clearing solid rail geometry; coordinate range alone is insufficient
physical_domain_contract.return: an AIRBORNE or RAIL_TOP_SUPPORTED path may re-enter CLOTH_SUPPORTED only through continuous collision/integration without teleport or clamp
physical_domain_contract.rest: supported motion may settle on cloth, rail top, or outside landing, but D6-A publishes no canonical departure/return/rest telemetry fact
physical_domain_contract.angular_motion: airborne angular velocity is conserved absent a resolved contact; contact impulses may change it using existing rigid contact conventions

geometry_and_topology_contract.rail_solid: closed analytic volume between the pocket-excised playfield boundary and sealed outer x/z extents, from cloth surface through rail top
geometry_and_topology_contract.pocket_openings: the existing six canonical corner/side mouth and throat frames carve openings; no extra visual aperture is authoritative
geometry_and_topology_contract.pocket_entry: POCKET_CHANNEL may be claimed only by a continuous downward crossing of the cloth support plane through an accepted canonical opening followed by the existing throat/capture topology
geometry_and_topology_contract.airborne_over_pocket: horizontal projection through a mouth while the sphere remains above the opening does not by itself capture the ball
geometry_and_topology_contract.pocket_departure_disjointness: a committed POCKET_CHANNEL path cannot also become a departure path; an outer-envelope departure path cannot also become pocket capture for the same continuous branch
geometry_and_topology_contract.same_toi_ambiguity: pocket and departure candidates at an indistinguishable TOI fail the physics step closed and roll back; no priority guess
geometry_and_topology_contract.candidate_order: absolute whole-tick TOI, then sealed physical-feature order and stable ball/feature identity; recursive tails are rebased to the original whole tick
geometry_and_topology_contract.maximum_event_exhaustion: rollback the whole step with no partial domain mutation

atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.staging: compute all 3D candidates and domain transitions on a temporary GameState
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.commit: publish position, velocity, angular state, physical domain and pocket state together only for a successful full tick
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.failed_step: restore the exact pre-step bytes relevant to ball, pocket and physical-domain state
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.dedupe: one resolved physical candidate per stable ball/feature/absolute-TOI identity; recursive-tail replay cannot apply it twice
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.fixed_step_equivalence: single whole tick and recursively split analytic tails must agree within the existing solver TOI tolerance and produce identical domain order
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.legacy_control: a cloth-supported ball with y velocity zero and no 3D collision candidate preserves current XZ motion, position-y support and pocket behavior
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.profile_migration: default and interactive profiles must opt into the same sealed D6-A geometry; a hidden disabled path cannot satisfy D6-A
atomicity_determinism_and_compatibility.reset: rack/reset/pocket reset explicitly assigns a valid physical domain and support height; no stale airborne/outside state survives

implementation_allowlist.cmake_scope: add table_departure_geometry.cpp to the existing core source list and at most one headless table-departure geometry test target; no product, renderer or GPU target

visual_evidence_invalidation_boundary.trigger: any authorized D6-A implementation changes shared ball state, canonical physics profile, integration or collision geometry
not_inheritable_for_current_build: Phase2 six-scene and targeted machine/TA evidence
Phase5 rules UI and official-rack machine/TA evidence whose source or binary manifest binds the shared core
any readiness or authorization template binding a pre-D6-A source or Billiards binary
visual_evidence_invalidation_boundary.semantically_unchanged_rules_cpu_receipt: may remain historical rule evidence but cannot attest the new integrated binary without fresh source/binary binding
required_successor_sequence: D6-A CPU fixtures and broad headless physics regression
D6-B canonical telemetry gate and implementation
fresh integrated Release build and source bindings
fresh targeted actual-GPU seven-scene physics set
only then successor Phase2/Phase4/Phase5 readiness or evidence claims
